upstreamFrontmatter.name: web-artifacts-builder
upstreamFrontmatter.description: Suite of tools for creating elaborate, multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts using modern frontend web technologies (React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui). Use for complex artifacts requiring state management, routing, or shadcn/ui components - not for simple single-file HTML/JSX artifacts.

adaptations: Restricted to user-selected local/browser/Obsidian execution; cloud, remote-provider and foreign-runtime branches disabled.
Russian discovery metadata and task-scoped invocation policy; original descriptions retained in upstreamFrontmatter.
